apps.name: Orbyt
apps.subtitle: Video app for Bluesky
apps.localizedDescription:
Orbyt is a video-first social app for the Bluesky network.

• Browse video feeds from Bluesky
• Create and share short-form videos
• Connect with the AT Protocol community
• Built with React Native and Expo

permissions.usageDescription: We need camera access to record videos for posts and take profile photos.
We need microphone access to record audio with your videos.
We need access to your photo library to select videos for posts and photos for your profile.
We need permission to save your videos to the camera roll.
